why: The lookahead's first rung under ADR 0083 to 0085. Its fitted set, lookahead-20, was searched under the old rules and collapsed under the new ones: on the 200 benchmark seeds mirrored it scores 0.087 against search-19, 0.142 against stun-first, 0.380 against greedy and 0.560 against pressure-floor, and the built-in weights do no better (0.000, 0.090, 0.547). The lookahead played with search-19's weights, which search 27 found no heuristic set above, is the strongest agent measured: 0.738 against search-19 itself, 0.900 against stun-first, 0.943 against greedy and 0.715 against pressure-floor (journal, 2026-09-28). So the rung starts from search-19 played as the lookahead, against those four heuristics, all under the start's floor, on content 813bb91b. search-23 and search-21 are left out of the panel because their matches against the lookahead run 26 to 28 rounds and cost three times as much. No check, to leave the hold-out its time. The budget is 3 rounds of 8, seed 0: a lookahead candidate against four heuristics costs about four to five minutes on a runner (search 20 took 3.5 against three), and 25 of them leave the hold-out room inside three hours. What would make it a rung: a set that, played as the lookahead, beats search-19's weights on seeds it never saw against search-19 and pressure-floor without falling below them against the rest.
